import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
base = Path("../checks/8de1c257a9c7/native-audit-final")
report = json.loads((base / "report.json").read_text())
rows = []
for episode in report["episodes"]:
    features = episode["features"]["test"]
    separated = features[2]
    large = features[3]
    assert separated["red_count"] == 3
    assert separated["output_cyan_count"] == 3 * separated["cyan_count"]
    assert (large["height"], large["width"]) == (30, 30)
    assert large["cyan_count"] >= 24 and large["red_count"] >= 10
    assert large["output_cyan_count"] >= 150
    assert large["output_bbox"][0] == 0 and large["output_bbox"][2] == 29
    assert large["output_bbox"][3] - large["output_bbox"][1] + 1 >= 24
    assert large["output_boundary_cells"] > 0
    assert episode["certificate_sha256_before_queries"] == episode["certificate_sha256_after_queries"]
    rows.append({"seed": episode["seed"], "setting": episode["settings"]["stamp_transform"],
                 "demos": episode["demos"], "survivors": episode["certificate"]["survivors"],
                 "query_shapes": [[f["height"],f["width"]] for f in features],
                 "query_red_counts": [f["red_count"] for f in features],
                 "separated_query": {"cyan_count": separated["cyan_count"],"output_cyan_count": separated["output_cyan_count"]},
                 "large_query": {k:large[k] for k in ("cyan_count","red_count","source_bbox","output_cyan_count","output_bbox","output_boundary_cells")},
                 "demo_even_overlap_cells": [f["even_overlap_cells"] for f in episode["features"]["train"][:2]]})
for item in report["source_files"]:
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(item["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == item["sha256"], item["path"]
print(json.dumps({"status":report["status"],"episodes":rows,"source_inventory_current":True,
                  "racket_evaluations":report["racket_evaluations"]},indent=2))
